Streets, schools and getting around Little Mountain

items.t: The City of Chilliwack publishes no street-by-street boundary for the name — not verified as an official boundary.
The anchor institution: Little Mountain Elementary at 9900 Carleton Street.
Nearby areas: downtown Chilliwack to the west, Fairfield Island across the Hope River side to the north, East Chilliwack to the east and southeast.

Where Chilliwack's verified 55+ housing actually is, for contrast: the valley floor — Downtown Chilliwack (Ivy Green), Chilliwack Proper (Knight Lodge, Mountainview Estates, Cottage Grove) and the Evans Road corridor (Cottonwood Village park). None of it is on the hill.
Health: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Rd, is a Fraser Health community hospital with emergency and acute care; the Chilliwack Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #104 - 7955 Evans Road.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Little Mountain

items.t: Hillside rules are the rules that actually bind a Little Mountain buyer: The Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 5500, Schedule D includes D-2 Hillside Environment and D-5 Hillside Development permit areas — hillside lots carry development-permit and geotechnical diligence that valley-floor lots do not. Confirm the specific lot's permit areas with the City before purchase.

City plan: Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 5500: presents the long-term vision and growth strategy for the whole city, including long-term growth strategies for residential (urban, rural and hillside), commercial, industrial and institutional uses.

City zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: sets Chilliwack's urban residential zones, including the R1-A (Urban Residential) Zone with a minimum lot area of 500 m2 on community water and sewer and a minimum lot width of 15 m on the same services, and the R1-C (Urban Infill) Zone with a minimum lot area of 300 m2 on an interior lot and 360 m2 on a corner lot.

SSMUH: Chilliwack's small-scale multi-unit housing amendments are in Bylaw No. 5395, adopted June 18, 2024. The Province later granted Chilliwack an extension for part of the Proper neighbourhood and surrounding Hazel Park area, with a new compliance date of Dec. 31, 2030 for that area — SSMUH timing is not uniform across the city.

Property taxes (2026, as published by the City): notices are mailed at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1; a 5% penalty applies for taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% for taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.

Good to know about Little Mountain

items.t: Two different hills share almost the same name, and the listings cross them. Little Mountain is the small hill east of downtown (Little Mountain Elementary, 9900 Carleton St); Chilliwack Mountain is the separate community on the south side of the Fraser River, west of downtown. A "mountain" 55+ claim has to be pinned to a civic address before it means anything — Mountainview Estates is on neither hill.

The hill sits inside the OCP's hillside permit-area framework. Schedule D of the Chilliwack 2050 OCP (Bylaw No. 5500) carries both a Hillside Environment (D-2) and a Hillside Development (D-5) permit area — the paperwork layer behind the view lots.
A subdivision name on the hill could not be verified.

Chartwell Birchwood's own location copy names the view. The downtown retirement residence (45650 Patten Avenue) describes views of Mt. Cheam, the Eastern Hillsides and Little Mountain from the valley floor — the care anchor for the area sits below the hill, on Patten Avenue near the Landing Leisure Centre and Chilliwack General Hospital.

faq.a: No — none was verified in any source. The hill's confirmed stock is detached hillside houses; Chilliwack's verified 55+ complexes are on the valley floor downtown and in Chilliwack Proper.
faq.q: Is there any 55+ housing on Little Mountain itself?

faq.a: No. Mountainview Estates (46966 Yale Road) is a genuine 55+ complex, but it sits on Yale Road in Chilliwack Proper East — a valley-floor address. The name refers to the view, not the sub-area.

The OCP's hillside permit areas — D-2 Hillside Environment and D-5 Hillside Development (Schedule D of Bylaw No. 5500) — put development-permit and slope/geotechnical review into hillside purchases. Confirm the lot's permit areas and any registered geotechnical reports with the City and on title before removing subjects.
faq.q: What extra diligence does a hillside lot need?

faq.a: Chilliwack's SSMUH amendments (Bylaw No. 5395, adopted June 18, 2024) brought small-scale multi-unit housing into the city's single-residential zones — subject to the lot's zone and any hillside permit area on it. Confirm the specific lot with the City.
faq.q: Can I add a suite to a Little Mountain house for a caregiver or family member?

faq.a: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Rd, at the foot of the hill's west side — a Fraser Health community hospital with emergency and acute care. The Chilliwack Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #104 - 7955 Evans Road.
